doc: stages/readers.i3s.rst is new at 2.6.0 and its Options section names `filename` -- 'I3S file stored remotely. These must be prefaced with an "i3s://"' -- `threads` -- 'the number of threads that you would like to use while reading' -- `obb` -- 'An oriented bounding box used to filter the data being retrieved.' -- and `min_density and max_density` -- 'This is the range of density of the points in the nodes that will be selected during the read.'; the page also includes `stages/reader_opts.rst`, whose first entry is `count`, 'Maximum number of points to read. [Default: unlimited]'. The stage is registered at 2.6.0, so `pdal --options readers.i3s` (apps/index.rst) reports that table on stdout; at 2.5.0 the stage does not exist and stdout is empty. Option NAMES only: the binary's help sentences are not stated by any shipped page, so they are not graded (CASE_AUTHORING.md's rule against asserting undocumented message text) -- and neither is any default the binary prints, since the page's stated default for `threads` and the binary's own bracketed value disagree at this release. Unlike the stage's read path, which needs a live ArcGIS REST service, the option table is deterministic and offline. WHY THIS CASE AND `slpk-options` ARE NOT REDUNDANT EVEN THOUGH THE TWO TABLES COINCIDE: at 2.6.0 `pdal --options readers.i3s` and `pdal --options readers.slpk` print the same twelve names, because both stages derive from the same Esri reader base. What each case grades is the subset ITS OWN page documents, and those subsets differ -- `threads`, 'This specifies the number of threads that you would like to use while reading', is on `readers.i3s.rst` and on no slpk page, so it is asserted here and not there; `readers.slpk.rst` carries `dimensions` and the `.slpk`-extension `filename` rule instead. A candidate that registered only one of the two stages fails exactly one of the two cases, which is the independence the two cases exist for.
